name: onboardiq
description: OnboardIQ - KYC onboarding with rules engine and maker-checker (HCLTech BFSI Use Case 02)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
